The library is built with ASan. Now let me rebuild the fuzzer with ASan.

<｜｜DSML｜｜ode>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'cd /gt/_work/src && gcc -fsanitize=address -g -O1 -I./src/lib -I./src/include -I./fuzz -DNDPI_LIB_COMPILATION -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE=1 -D_GNU_SOURCE=1 -c fuzz/fuzz_filecfg_protocols.c -o /gt/_work/src/fuzz_filecfg_protocols_asan.o && gcc -fsanitize=address -g -O1 -I./src/lib -I./src/include -I./fuzz -DNDPI_LIB_COMPILATION -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE=1 -D_GNU_SOURCE=1 -c fuzz/fuzz_common_code.c -o /gt/_work/src/fuzz_common_code_asan.o && gcc -fsanitize=address -g -O1 -I./src/lib -I./src/include -I./fuzz -DNDPI_LIB_COMPILATION -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE=1 -D_GNU_SOURCE=1 -c test_harness.c -o /gt/_work/src/test_harness_asan.o && gcc -fsanitize=address -g -O1 test_harness_asan.o fuzz_filecfg_protocols_asan.o fuzz_common_code_asan.o src/lib/libndpi.a -lm -lpthread -o /gt/_work/src/fuzz_filecfg_protocols_asan && echo "LINKED OK"'</｜｜DSML｜｜ode>
